CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  Tuesday, March 16, 2021 - 6:30 P.M.

  City Hall Council Chamber
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, California 91776
  Due to Executive Order N-25-20 Members of the Council may
  Teleconference into the meeting.
  Denise Menchaca  Mark Lazzaretto
  Mayor  City Manager

  Chin Ho Liao  Keith Lemieux
  Vice Mayor  City Attorney

  Tony Ding  Julie Nguyen
  Council Member  City Clerk

  John R. Harrington  Kevin B. Sawkins
  Council Member  City Treasurer

  Jason Pu
  Council Member

Pursuant to State and County Directives, San Gabriel City Hall is closed to the public and physical access
to the meeting has been suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an
opportunity to comment on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have been
established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to cityclerk@sgch.org and include the following on the subject line of
your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent, Public Hearing, Continued Business, New Business) and
Item Number you are commenting on. The Clerk will read public comments into the record for up to the
three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and
discriminatory language, will not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A
Watch the Meeting Online
Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
City Council Meeting Videos
Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.
   City Council Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, March 16, 2021

    CALL TO ORDER
    PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Councilmember Harrington
    ROLL CALL: Mayor Menchaca, Vice Mayor Liao, Council Members Ding,
  Harrington, Pu

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  2. PRESENTATION

  A. STATE OF THE CITY
  B. PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING MARCH 2021 AS WOMEN’S HISTORY
  MONTH
  C. COVID-19 BRIEFING

  D. ASIAN CRIME VICTIMS WORKING GROUP

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of March 2, 2021.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The most recent Material Demands from the Finance Department are
  presented to the City Council for review and approval.

  2
City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 16, 2021
   Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT – FEBRUARY 2021

  In accordance with the City of San Gabriel’s 2020-21 Adopted Investment
  Policy (Resolution No. 20-30 dated June 16, 2020) and California Government
  Code §53646, the Finance Director is to render an investment report to the
  City Council, City Treasurer, City Manager, and the City Attorney. The February
  2021 Cash and Investment Report is presented to receive and file in
  accordance with the City’s adopted 2020-21 Investment Policy.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for February 2021.

  D. MONTHLY BUDGET UPDATE – FEBRUARY 2021

  This report provides and update on the City’s General Fund budget and
  financial position as of February 28, 2021 (prior to the monthly closing
  entries). The monthly budget update incorporates impacts from the COVID-
  19 pandemic and other external factors on revenues and operations, and
  provides a projection for the fiscal year that ends on June 30, 2021.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the report.

  E. AGREEMENT WITH INTRANET INCORPORATED FOR INFORMATION
  TECHNOLOGY SERVICES

  The City of San Gabriel contracts a portion of the professional services needed
  for the City’s information technology (IT) infrastructure and solutions. Staff is
  presenting a professional services agreement with Intranet Incorporated to
  provide information technology services on a month-to-month basis at a rate
  of seventy-five dollars per hour. Intranet Incorporated has provided IT
  professional services to the City for over 20 years and has in-depth knowledge
  of the City’s IT infrastructure and solutions.

  Recommended Action:

  3
City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 16, 2021
   Staff recommends that the City Council approve a professional services
  agreement with Intranet Incorporated.

  F. ACCEPTANCE OF FINAL TRACT MAP NO. 82328 (144 SAINT FRANCIS
  STREET) PLANNING CASE NO. TMAP18-013

  The development, located at 144 Saint Francis Street, is a five-unit
  condominium development on a 9,380 square foot lot. City Staff and the Los
  Angeles County Department of Public Works have reviewed the Final Parcel
  Map and have determined it is in compliance with the State Subdivision Map
  Act, conditions of approval, and the City’s ordinances regarding subdivision.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council accept the Final Parcel Map No. 82328
  and authorize filing with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS – None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. RECEIVE AND FILE UPDATE ON 10- POINT PLAN FOR RECOVERY,
  RESILIENCY, AND REINVESTMENT, AND AUTHORIZE ESTABLISHMENT
  OF BUSINESS ASSISTANCE FUND FROM EXISTING ECONOMIC
  DEVELOPMENT BUDGET

  In response to the pandemic, the Economic Development Division created a
  10-Point Plan for Recovery, Resiliency, and Reinvestment to help mitigate the
  financial impacts of the novel coronavirus pandemic (COVID-19) on our
  community. This staff report provides an update of efforts in 2020, revisions
  or new programming for 2021, and requests City Council’s direction on
  creating a Business Assistance Fund for the City to financially assist San
  Gabriel businesses most hard hit from the pandemic on a case-by-case basis.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the update on a 10-
  Point Plan and establish the Business Assistance Fund.

  B. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

  4
City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – March 16, 2021
   The City Council will select a new Mayor and Vice-Mayor for the coming
  year.

  8. PUBLIC COMMENT

  9. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

  10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of
  general information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members
  to report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

  11. CLOSED SESSION – None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 6, 2021, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will
  be available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website
  at www.sangabrielcity.com.

 Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
 www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter. Materials related to an item on this Agenda,
 submitted to the City Council after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on
 the City website.
 Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in
 appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202
 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
 Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting
 must notify the City Clerk’s Department at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before
 the meeting.
 Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
 the above Agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the City Clerk at
 cityclerk@sgch.org during regular office hours.

 Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
 participate in a meeting should direct such a request to the City Clerk Department by
 emailing cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting, if possible.

MINUTES OF MARCH 16, 2021
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  6:31 P.M. on Tuesday, March 16, 2021, with all Council Members and staff participating
  by teleconference.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR (GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6)

  City Negotiators - City Manager Lazzaretto, City Attorney Lemieux, and Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Macias.
  Regarding the following Employee Organizations - San Gabriel Fire Management Group

  City Attorney Lemieux announced that in the preceding special meeting, no reportable
  action was taken on the closed session item.

I  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Harrington.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, John R. Harrington, Jason Pu, Vice Mayor
  Chin Ho Liao, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City
  Manager/Community Development Director Armine
  Chaparyan, City Attorney Keith Lemieux, Community
  Services/Interim Mission Playhouse Director Rebecca
  Perez, Police Chief Eugene Harris, Chief City Clerk
  Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City Engineer Greg
  de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace, Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  Finance Director William Kaholokula, and Assistant City
  Clerk Marilyn Bonus.

I  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Chief City Clerk Clark provided information for the public on how to view the meeting and
  submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca requested that New Business Item ?B, City Council Reorganization,
  be moved to after Council Comments to facilitate meeting flow.

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 5  March 16, 2021
   A motion was made by Council Member Pu, seconded by Vice Mayor Liao, to approve
  the agenda order as amended.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HARRINGTON, PU, LIAO, MENCHACA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

I  2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. STATE OF THE CITY

  Mayor Menchaca made the presentation.

  B. PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING MARCH 2021  AS WOMEN'S HISTORY
  MONTH

  Mayo r Menchaca made the presentation.

  C. COVID- 19 BRIEFING

  Fire Chief Wallace and Police Chief Harris made the presentation.

  D. ASIAN CRIME VICTIMS WORKING GROUP

  Po lice Chief Harris made the presentation.

I  3. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.
  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A motion was made by Vice Mayo Liao, seconded by Mayor Menchaca, to approve
  Consent Calendar Items 4A- 4F as presented.

  Motion approved Consent Calendar Items 4A- 4F as presented by a vote of 5-0 as
  follows:

  AYES:  DING, HARRINGTON, PU, LIAO, MENCHACA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN :  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council approved the Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of
  March 2, 2021 .

I  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  Th e City Council approved the February 18, 2021, and February 25, 2021, Reg isters
  of Demands and Warrants for the payment of City expenditures.

  C. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT - FEBRUARY 2021

  The City Council received and filed the Cash and Investment Report for February
  2021 .

  CITY COUNCI L REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 5  Ma rch 16, 2021
   D. MONTHLY BUDGET UPDATE - FEBRUARY 202 1

  The City Council received and filed the report.

  E. AGREEMENT WITH INTRANET  INCORPORATED  FOR  INFORMATION
  TECHNOLOGY SERVICES

  The City Council approved a professional services agreement with Intranet
  Incorporated.

I  F. ACCEPTANCE OF FINAL TRACT MAP NO. 82328 (144 SAINT FRANCIS STREET)
  PLANNING CASE NO. TMAP18-013

  The City Council accepted Final Parcel Map No. 82328 and authorized filing with
  th e Los Angeles County Recorder.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING - None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS - None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. RECEIVE AND FILE UPDATE ON 10-POINT PLAN FOR RECOVERY, RESILIENCY,
  AND REINVESTMENT, AND AUTHORIZE ESTABLISHMENT OF BUSINESS
  ASSISTANCE FUND FROM EXISTING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT BUDGET

  Economic Development Manager Domenica Megerdichian made the staff

I
  presentation.

  There was no public comment.

  Discussion included commendation to Economic Development staff and the 10-
  Point Plan Subcommittee for administrating grants to businesses and renters;
  funding opti ons for the Business Assistance Fund and additional small business
  grants; rent relief for tenants; adapting to new state guidelines; education and
  assistance for restaurants transitioning through COVID-19 tier regulations;
  engaging restaurants t o assist with the senior meal program; and consideration for
  restaurants to continue outdoor dining options.

  A motion was made by Mayor Menchaca, seconded by Vice Mayor Liao, to receive
  and file the update on the 10-Point Plan and to establish the Business Assistance
  Fund.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HARRINGTON, PU, LIAO, MENCHACA

I
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABS ENT:  NONE

  8. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

  9. CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

  City Manager Lazzaretto congratulated Mayor Menchaca on her State of the City
  address, and announced that staff will be bringing a presentation to the City Council
  in April 2021 on what changes developers are requesting for 2022 and beyond.
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 3 of 5  March 16, 2021
   10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS
  Vice Mayor Liao reported on the National League of Cities conference.

  Council Member Pu thanked and congratulated Mayor Menchaca on a successful year
  as Mayor.

  Council Member Ding congratulated Mayor Menchaca and commended City Manager
  Lazzaretto for their work together; commended City staff for implementing virtual

I  meetings; thanked staff and his Council colleagues for helping him learn during his
  first year on the City Council; and thanked Police Volunteer Sue Fitzsimmons for her
  K-9 fundraising work and San Gabriel Hope Lions Club for their contribution to that
  cause.

  Council Member Harrington thanked Mayor Menchaca for her leadership over the past
  year.

  Mayor Menchaca stated it has been a pleasure working with her Council colleagues.

  8. NEW BUSINESS - CONTINUED

  B. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

  a. Selection of Mayor

  Chief City Clerk Clark declared the offices of Mayor and Vice Mayor vacant, and
  opened the floor for nominations for Mayor.

I  Council Member Menchaca nominated Council Member Liao.

  There were no other nominations; therefore, Chief City Clerk Clark announced
  that Council Member Liao had been selected as Mayor by acclamation, and
  administered his Oath of Office.

  b. Selection of Vice Mayor
  Mayor Liao opened the floor for nominations for Vice-Mayor. Council Member
  Pu nominated Council Member Ding. Council Member Ding nominated Council
  Member Harrington. Council Member Harrington declined the nomination.

  There were no other nominations; therefore, Mayor Liao announced that
  Council Member Ding had been selected as Vice Mayor by acclamation.

  11. CLOSED SESSION - None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

I  Mayor Liao adjourned the meeting at 8:37 P.M .

  Respectfully submitted:

  JULIE NGUYEN, City Clerk
